desc: Fuse the Ironsing rods from Ironsing mantras and Blood Poison from Bloodrend mantras into a composite plasma that flows in your opponents blood. Your Bloodrend mantras are now silver.
name: Composite Path: Alloyblood
additional_info: Your Metal Rod and Blood Poison buildup is replaced with Composite Alloy buildup. A certain threshold of Composite Alloy must be built up to cast Alloyblood Mantras.
